value.question: Can I edit or delete a custom field after creating it?
Are there any limitations on the number of custom fields I can create?
Can I rearrange the order of custom fields in the deal form?
How can I ensure my team fills in important fields?

text.value: The Deal Field Configuration feature in the CRM allows users to create and manage custom fields specific to their business needs. Users can add, edit, and organize fields to capture relevant deal information that aligns with their sales processes. Custom fields can be of various types, including text, number, date, dropdowns, checkboxes, and more.
